identity: Selesnya landfall token swarm. Eusocial Engineering turns every land ETB into a 2/2 Robot, and Lander tokens manufacture those ETBs on demand at instant speed for {2}. Exalted Sunborn doubles every token created under your control - the Robots AND the Landers themselves, so one Sami's Curiosity becomes two Landers and one land drop becomes two Robots. Bioengineered Future then makes each of those Robots enter with a +1/+1 counter for every land that entered this turn - and because Eusocial Engineering's Robot is created BY the land ETB, it is always created after that land is already on the battlefield, so the counter is never zero. Loading Zone doubles every one of those counters and every Station charge counter, which turns Lumen-Class Frigate's board-wide anthem on off a single tap. The Lander package doubles as the manabase, because 'search your library for a basic land card' fetches either basic and this colour pair has exactly one free dual.

restrictions.max 6 rare+mythic cards across mainboard: PASS - 6 used, exactly at the cap: Lumen-Class Frigate, Bioengineered Future, Cosmogrand Zenith, Exalted Sunborn and Loading Zone (mainboard) plus Beyond the Quiet (sideboard)

identity_es: Enjambre de fichas con landfall Selesnya. Eusocial Engineering convierte cada entrada de tierra en un Robot 2/2, y las fichas de Lander fabrican esas entradas a demanda y a velocidad de instantáneo por {2}. Exalted Sunborn duplica cada ficha creada bajo tu control — los Robots Y los propios Landers — así que una Sami's Curiosity se vuelve dos Landers y una tierra jugada se vuelve dos Robots. Bioengineered Future hace entonces que cada uno de esos Robots entre con un contador +1/+1 por cada tierra que haya entrado ese turno; y como el Robot de Eusocial Engineering lo crea LA PROPIA entrada de la tierra, siempre se crea cuando esa tierra ya está en el campo de batalla, así que el contador nunca es cero. Loading Zone duplica cada uno de esos contadores y cada contador de carga de Station, lo que activa el anthem para todo el tablero de Lumen-Class Frigate con un solo giro. El paquete de Landers hace además de base de maná, porque 'search your library for a basic land card' busca cualquiera de las dos básicas y esta pareja de colores tiene exactamente una dual gratuita.
